candidate_system.geographic_system: Canary Islands plus Western Sahara reference

independence_boundary: Canary Islands were previously present in the ABM v4 coarse richness/link global validation. Therefore this is not a fully independent test of the entire v4-v6 hierarchy. The source gate is intended as a layer-specific held-out test of site-level local support and raw weighted architecture. The 14 source-native site matrices, their Shannon values, plant niche-overlap values, and within-island site contrasts were not used to formulate ABM v6.

required_before_any_target: recover the Dryad dataset landing page or API metadata
recover exactly 14 source-native site matrix CSV files
preserve the source-defined site identities and island grouping
verify every matrix is quantitative and non-negative
record byte counts and SHA256 for every admitted file
do not calculate Shannon, plant niche overlap, or any v6 predictive fit
source_only_gate.matrix_semantics: Dryad usage notes define pollinators in rows, plants in columns, and matrix values as total observed visits between plants and pollinators.
source_only_gate.distance_file_role: Distance_between_sites_Dryad.csv may be recovered for source-structure audit but may not be used to select, drop, merge, or regroup local networks after target inspection.
source_only_gate.blocked_rule: If fewer than 14 exact site matrices are lawfully recovered, if the matrix schema is not quantitative, or if source-defined site identities cannot be preserved, block the validation and do not substitute aggregated Canary matrices from another publication.

prohibited_before_source_admission: merge the two replicate sites on any island
select only Tenerife or another island based on network values
replace source visit counts with a derived or standardized interaction measure
